name: Long Exhale Breathing

instructions.description: Sit, stand, or lie in a comfortable position with your jaw relaxed.
Inhale gently through the nose for a short comfortable count.
Exhale slowly for a longer count through the nose or lightly pursed lips.
Continue for repeated cycles while keeping the effort minimal.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use an exhale that is longer than the inhale but still comfortable.
A one-to-two inhale-to-exhale ratio is a common starting point.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use pursed lips during the longer exhale if that feels easier.

commentsNotes: Do not force the end of the exhale.
Shorten the count if you feel dizzy.
